title: Systematic Data Extraction for a Review on the Role of Cytokines in Breast Cancer Progression
author: Sebastian Ciurescu

steps.title: Prepare Required Tools and Software
steps.instruction: Ensure access to the necessary hardware, software, and databases for the systematic review.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a computer with internet access
Install Mendeley reference manager
Prepare PRISMA 2020 flow diagram template
Prepare Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word
Install JASP v0.19.3 for meta-analysis
Ensure access to PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science databases

steps.title: Define Eligibility Criteria
steps.instruction: Establish the inclusion and exclusion parameters for the study selection.

substeps.instruction: Include: Original research studies in humans, published between 2015 and 2025, evaluating cytokines in relation to breast cancer prognosis or therapeutic potential
Exclude: Animal or in vitro studies, case reports, editorials, and reviews

steps.title: Search Databases
steps.instruction: Perform a comprehensive literature search across the selected databases.

substeps.instruction: Apply filters for publication year (2015–2025), human subjects, and English language

steps.title: Export and De-duplicate Records
steps.instruction: Manage the search results to remove redundant entries.

substeps.instruction: Export all search results into Mendeley
Remove duplicate records automatically and manually

steps.title: Retrieve Full-Text and Assess Eligibility
steps.instruction: Evaluate the full texts of potentially eligible studies against the predefined criteria.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve full texts for potentially eligible studies
Assess full texts against eligibility criteria
Resolve any discrepancies during screening via consensus or adjudication by a third reviewer

steps.title: Extract Data
steps.instruction: Extract specific variables from each included study using a standardized Excel sheet with predefined columns.

substeps.instruction: Extract study characteristics: author, year, country, study design
Extract population data: sample size, patient subgroup
Extract cytokines evaluated and measurement method (e.g., ELISA, IHC)
Extract outcomes: survival (OS, DFS), response to therapy, metastasis
Extract statistical estimates (e.g., HR, OR, CI) and type of analysis (univariate or multivariate)
Extract therapeutic interventions, if applicable
Validate extracted data by cross-checking between reviewers
Resolve any discrepancies during extraction via consensus or adjudication by a third reviewer

steps.title: Assess Risk of Bias and Quality
steps.instruction: Evaluate the quality of the included studies and the consistency of the data.

substeps.instruction: Apply Newcastle–Ottawa Scale for observational studies
Assess heterogeneity using I² for meta-analysis
Assess publication bias via funnel plots

steps.title: Synthesize Findings
steps.instruction: Perform qualitative and quantitative analysis of the extracted data.

substeps.instruction: Group cytokines by function (pro-inflammatory, immunosuppressive, or regulatory) to guide synthesis
Summarize qualitative findings by cytokine and clinical outcome
Perform quantitative meta-analysis where appropriate using random-effects models
Exclude studies from meta-analysis that lack hazard ratios but provide Kaplan–Meier curves (retain these for qualitative discussion)

steps.title: Document PRISMA Compliance
steps.instruction: Complete the PRISMA 2020 flow diagram detailing the identification, screening, eligibility, and inclusion process.

description: Step 4: Title and abstract screening Screen all records independently by two reviewers. Exclude non-relevant articles. Document reasons for exclusion.
